findings.issue: “One proton moves” reads as a universal limit of one proton per acid-base reaction. Overall acid-base equations can involve transfer of more than one proton. Replace it with “Track the transferred proton(s); identify each species by whether it donates or accepts H⁺.”
findings.evidence: The source reference and CED define acid-base reactions as transferring “one or more protons.” The source instruction to “Track one proton through the equation” is a tracking strategy, not a restriction on the number transferred.
